# Border Radius

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

圆角。默认水标约 4px（`--radius`）。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: rounded-md bg-muted p-sm
    tpl: rounded-md
  - type: tpl
    className: rounded-xl bg-muted p-sm m-t-sm
    tpl: rounded-xl
  - type: tpl
    className: rounded-full bg-muted p-sm m-t-sm w-24 text-center
    tpl: rounded-full
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `rounded-none` | `0` |
| `rounded-sm` | `小` |
| `rounded-md` | `默认档` |
| `rounded-lg` | `较大` |
| `rounded-xl` | `更大` |
| `rounded-full` | `胶囊 / 圆` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
